description: This file defines the Customer report model for the OpenCart admin module. It provides various methods to retrieve customer-related statistical data such as counts by day, week, month, and year, as well as detailed customer lists, orders, reward points, activities, and searches, often filtered by date ranges or groups.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Model class for fetching customer-related reports and statistics within the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByDay
methods.description: Returns an array with the count of new customers for each hour of the current day.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByWeek
methods.description: Returns an array with the count of new customers for each day of the current week.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByMonth
methods.description: Returns an array with the count of new customers for each day of the current month.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByYear
methods.description: Returns an array with the count of new customers for each month of the current year.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers based on optional filters such as date range, group, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCustomers
methods.description: Returns the total number of customer records, optionally filtered by date range.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Provides a list of orders with customer info and filtering options.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns total count of orders with optional filters.

methods.name: getRewardPoints
methods.description: Returns customer reward points and related info, with filters.

methods.name: getTotalRewardPoints
methods.description: Returns total number of reward point records with optional filters.

methods.name: getCustomerActivities
methods.description: Fetches customer activity logs, filtered by date and other criteria.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerActivities
methods.description: Counts total customer activity records filtered by criteria.

methods.name: getCustomerSearches
methods.description: Retrieves customer search records with optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerSearches
methods.description: Counts total customer search records based on filters.
